title: Listen and choose 2.4
role: Guide telling a colleague what happened during a group visit
can_do: I can tell a past event with the past simple and the past continuous.
I can link ideas with while, when, but, so and although.

items.prompt: What did the speaker do when it started to rain?
items.explanation: The speaker says: it started to rain, so I took a taxi.

items.prompt: What did they do with the tables?
items.explanation: The speaker says: we moved the tables inside.

items.prompt: What did the airline give the passengers?
items.explanation: The speaker says: a free lunch.
